post_ship_review.fix: 10 findings adjudicated: 8 CONFIRMED + 2 NEEDS_NUANCE, all fixed. (1) §2.1 removed Voyager from the policy-gradient unification list — it freezes weights and uses no reward (contradicted §4.1). (2) TL;DR mislabeled STaR's grounding as 'math checker'; corrected to 'ground-truth-answer matching + rationalization'. (3) §3.2 Native Evolution K bullet list had copy-forward contamination from the unrelated §7.2 A²RD/MVMem video-memory schema (Visual arcs/Camera states); replaced with a text/web-agent-appropriate list (site map, entity/page relations, failure notes). (4) §5.3 Easy-set selection prose claimed 'fewest rubric passes' which is undefined once solved := all(rubric) (pass_rate always 1.0); reworded to match what the code actually does, plus the Laplace-smoothing formula/code changed from (s+1)/(n+1) to the textbook (s+1)/(n+2) rule of succession (both prose formula and the laplace_smoothed_rate() code+docstring). (5) §6.5 section heading said '14B Qwen3' while the table below is Qwen3-30B; heading corrected, 14B noted as the separate transfer-learning result. (6) Q14 KL-grounding derivation illegitimately flipped a proven lower bound into an asserted upper bound; reworded as an explicit heuristic with no claimed monotone-improvement theorem. (7) §12.1 KL penalty on skill-set markdown diffs is undefined (KL requires probability distributions, not deterministic text); relabeled as a generic divergence-like penalty with BLEU/edit-distance as the approximation, with an explicit non-KL caveat. (8) Q21 monotone-convergence claim used a fixed per-iteration failure prob delta without a summability requirement; added sum_i delta_i < infinity, and added a Borel-Cantelli caveat plus a note that score convergence doesn't rule out skill-set oscillation. (9) Q22 stated K* = argmax I(K;E) as if it were Native Evolution's actual training objective and used DPI to assert a monotone Success-vs-MI relationship; added a caveat that the real training signal is the outcome-based R_evolve (§6.2), and the MI story is only a post-hoc heuristic, not an equivalence. (10) Q18 Generative Agents decay factor corrected from gamma=0.995/hour to the paper's gamma=0.99/hour; Q19 MemoryBank 'inspired by MemGPT' claim was chronologically impossible (MemoryBank predates MemGPT by ~5 months) — corrected to independent concurrent development.
